title: Meatless Cajun Cabbage Soup
description: Healthier Cajun food doesn't get yummier than this super easy cabbage soup packed with veggies and seasonings from the Bayou.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or to taste
2 cloves garlic, minced, or more to taste
1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
2 teaspoons browning sauce (such as Kitchen Bouquet®)
1 pinch Cajun seasoning (such as Tony Chachere's), or to taste

steps.text: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery. Saute until vegetables are tender and starting to brown, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper. Pour in chicken stock, water, and browning sauce.

Bring soup to a boil; reduce heat to low. Add cabbage, diced tomatoes, hot sauce, bay leaf, and Cajun seasoning. Simmer until cabbage is tender and liquid is reduced by half, 25 to 30 minutes. Adjust seasoning as needed.
